method: Live computer use via @oai/sky, observed physical coordinates and fresh state following each click; significant frames inspected. Canonical ID sequences below are ordered physical presses, with setup state explicitly stated. No simulator images distributed.

liveObservations.setup: Fresh simulator Reset, NORMAL, DEG, NORM1
liveObservations.observed: SET UP labels DRG FSE TAB; lower 0. 1; TAB numeric shortcut ignored under NORM; UP/DOWN do not change this single page; ON/C cancels and clears command.
FSE begins FIX SCI ENG, indices 0. 1 2; DOWN shows NORM1 NORM2, indices 3. 4; another DOWN returns first page; UP also cycles pages.
FIX selection returns directly to 0.000000000, without TAB prompt. SET UP 2 opens TAB(0-9)? with blank lower. ENT leaves prompt unchanged. Digit 2 commits 0.00. FIX DEG indicators.
1/3 displays 0.33; SCI selection reformats same current result to 3.33 times 10^-01; SCI DEG indicators. Entry digits keep their own decimal point rather than TAB zeros.
TAB0 SCI is 3. times 10^-01; ENG then displays 333. times 10^-03. ENG DEG indicators.
DRG opens DEG RAD GRAD, indices 0. 1 2. ON/C returns to blank command, 0. times 10^00.
Entry and result show 1'234'567'890.; expression 1234567890= carries no grouping punctuation. Ten mantissa digits; apostrophe grouping and decimal dot on English pinned simulator.
1E-09 displays 0.000000001 in NORM1; switching to NORM2 displays 1. times 10^-09. Both retain same value.
1.234E-09 displays 0.000000001, confirming the ten LCD digits include the leading zero and fractional leading zeros.
FIX TAB1 displays 0.0 while retaining internal value; not forced scientific notation for a small number.
1E10 overflows decimal capacity and displays 1. times 10^10, with FIX indicator and no forced TAB trailing zero in this overflow view.
123456789 + .95 displays 123456790.0; nine integer digits leave one fractional digit, which is rounded.
(-1)/100 displays -0.0. Negative sign survives nonzero values rounded to zero.
1234 result displays 1'234.0, retaining three-digit punctuation in FIX.
MDF leaves display unchanged, switching to NORM1 shows .14286; ANS times 7 gives 1.00002, confirming modified internal precision.

liveObservations.setup: NORMAL NORM1, fresh ON/C after setting NORM1
liveObservations.observed: 1 a/b 3 ENT displays exact 1/3; MDF leaves this fraction unchanged; ANS times 3 gives 1., so MDF does not truncate an exact fraction to the decimal NORM mantissa.

9999999999 + .1 remains decimal, displayed 9'999'999'999. Fractional values above the manual's printed largest ten-digit integer remain decimal until 1e10; simulator measurement resolves the precise threshold.
Scientific literal entry preserves a negative exponent sign at zero: 1. times 10^-00.

manualRules.guidePage5: NORM1 decimal interval is 1e-9 through 9999999999 inclusive by magnitude; NORM2 is .01 through 9999999999 inclusive. Outside use ten-digit mantissa and two-digit exponent. Live simulator refinement: 9999999999 + .1 still uses decimal notation, so actual upper decimal cutoff is 1e10 exclusive; the printed maximum describes ten-digit integer capacity.
manualRules.guidePage11: FIX TAB1: 5/9 is displayed .6; ordinary times 9 produces 5.0. MDF commits .6 and times 9 produces 5.4.
manualRules.engineering: Engineering exponent is a multiple of three; TAB counts mantissa decimal places, capped by the ten-digit LCD capacity.
manualRules.locale: English pinned simulator uses apostrophes for integer groups and dot decimals. No regional toggle was exposed or measured; other locales are unassessed. Host locale does not change this reference profile.

coverage.EL506-070: Physical SET UP, DRG/FSE submenus, TAB availability/prompt, numeric and cursor selection, page cycling, cancellation and persistence.
coverage.EL506-071: NORM1 inclusive thresholds and truncation, positive/negative boundary assertions.
coverage.EL506-072: NORM2 inclusive thresholds and format switching preserves internal values.
coverage.EL506-073: TAB 0-9; FIX half-away rounding, capacity clipping, trailing zeros and overflow notation.
coverage.EL506-074: SCI TAB n means n mantissa decimal places (n+1 significant digits), including TAB0 and carry.
coverage.EL506-075: ENG auto exponent multiples of three, one through three integer mantissa digits, capped fractional precision and carry.
coverage.EL506-076: Ten-digit mantissa, decimal capacity, scientific exponent zero padding and upper-range overflow protection.
coverage.EL506-077: Pinned English grouping and decimal punctuation on entry/results; locale limitations stated.
coverage.EL506-078: Integer decimal dots, explicit entry zeros, signed rounded zero and configured trailing zeros.
coverage.EL506-079: Live MDF fixture and unit/browser modified vs unmodified chains; immutable prior history and other stores.
coverage.EL506-080: Dedicated pure typed formatting and paged views for scalar/rational/DMS/complex/N-base/statistics/equation/matrix/list; immutable typed source. Numerical mode algorithms and their native paging semantics remain assigned to subsequent phases.

limitations: Raw legacy reducer strings remain separate from the physical formatted view and are explicitly reported as golden differences.
This completes formatting infrastructure, not statistical, equation, complex, N-base, matrix or list calculations. Those controllers have later roadmap owners.
